message.content:
This editorial illustration is a vertical magazine cover. A woman with dark, tied-back hair and a light purple, long-sleeved shirt is depicted mid-air in a balletic pose. Her left leg is bent at the knee, while her right leg points downward, and her arms are extended horizontally. She has an open-mouthed expression. 

The woman is positioned in front of a large, dark brown, leather-textured office chair that has been dismantled into three floating pieces: the high-backed seat, a detached armrest, and a five-wheeled base. Small debris, including a screw and a thin rod, float around the chair components.

The background is light gray with a solid red border on the left. The large, white word "TEMPO" is partially obscured by the woman. Text at the top reads "PELOBIKOMPROMI PERTEMUAN MRT" and "JARINGAN PENGATUR ANGGARAN DAERAH." Large black text below the woman reads "ABRAKADABRA! BUMN INDUK." A block of Indonesian text follows. In the bottom right, there is a date "22-28 JULI 2019," a price, a website, an ISSN number, and a barcode.
